articles.title: President Ilham Aliyev receives Deputy Prime Minister of Georgia
articles.summary: President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev received Mariam Kvrivishvili, Deputy Prime Minister of Georgia and Minister of Economy and Sustainable Development, on November 17.

articles.title: President Ilham Aliyev receives delegation led by German FM
articles.summary: President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev received a delegation led by German Federal Minister for Foreign Affairs Johann David Wadephul on November 17.
